concerns.text: FR-001 (filtering >500 lines) and SC-001 (Pass@1 measurement) lack an executable task to generate the filtered dataset artifact. Task T012b (write filtered dataset to parquet) is present but unchecked `[ ]`, while T016 (run baseline) depends on this filtered set. Without T012b completion, the baseline execution cannot run on the correct data scope.

FR-007 (60-min/72h budget) has no executable task for the 1B baseline run. Task T016b (batch_executor) is unchecked `[ ]`, and T016 (run_baseline) lacks explicit enforcement logic in its description. The plan requires T016b to be complete before T016 can satisfy the runtime budget constraint.

FR-008 (failure mode classification) has no executable task for US-1 results. Task T017 (failure_classifier) and T017b (apply classifier) are both unchecked `[ ]`. The spec requires failure modes to be recorded for every configuration (FR-005), but no task exists to produce this data for the baseline run.

FR-007 (runtime budget) and FR-008 (failure classification) are missing executable tasks for US-2. Task T023 (run_high_fidelity) is unchecked `[ ]` and lacks explicit budget enforcement logic. Task T017c (apply classifier to US-2) is unchecked `[ ]`. T024 (fallback logic) is also unchecked, leaving the edge case handling unimplemented.

FR-004 (7B model execution) and FR-006 (GLM analysis) lack executable tasks. Task T027 (run 7B) is unchecked `[ ]`. Task T028 (merge results) is unchecked `[ ]`. Task T029 (GLM analyzer) and T030 (post-hoc comparison) are unchecked `[ ]`. SC-003 and SC-004 cannot be measured without these tasks.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksumming derived data. Task T012b (write filtered dataset and record checksum) is unchecked `[ ]`. Task T039 (checksum generation for ALL artifacts) is also unchecked `[ ]`. The plan cannot satisfy the Data Hygiene requirement without these tasks being executed.

FR-005 (record Pass@1, tokens, failure modes) relies on T008b (merge results) to create the SSoT. Task T008b is unchecked `[ ]`. Without this, the aggregated results required for SC-001, SC-002, and SC-005 cannot be produced.

Task T004 and T004b both use ID 'T004'. T004b is listed as 'T004b' in the text but the ID collision with T004 creates ambiguity in the task list. This is a writing/formatting issue that needs correction to ensure unique task identifiers.

Task T006a and T006b have inconsistent status. T006a is marked `[X]` (complete) but T006b (create entity schemas) is unchecked `[ ]`. The plan requires schemas for the merge logic (T008a), so T006b must be completed to satisfy the data contract requirement.
